creator: Your Name

audience.who: one sentence: the role and situation of the people you want to be recognised by (e.g. 'heads of marketing at Series B software companies who own pipeline')
audience.known_for: the one sentence you want them to say about you
proof: 1 to 3 results or stories you own that a competitor cannot claim (number and date)
audience.channel: the one surface you show up on every week
audience._comment: Asked at step 2 of discovery, before niche. Relevance is a relation between you and a specific group; every gate, the selector and the north star read this block. icp_regex marks a person in the people ledger as in-audience from their headline.

niche: one line: the subject you want to be known for (e.g. 'restaurant marketing', 'indie game dev', 'personal finance for freelancers')

voice.note: the voice is MEASURED from voice-corpus/, never described; this block holds only the corpus settings
voice._comment: A harvested call whose title matches this regex is filed as on-subject speech (the register the targets are derived from). Everything else is banter and does not feed the targets.

primary_lane.label: Industry
primary_lane.definition: your core niche: teach real, concrete value in your subject (educational / insight led)

secondary_lane.label: Viral videos
secondary_lane.definition: reach plays adjacent to your niche: borrow a proven viral mechanic to go viral. Lighter, less educational, optional.
secondary_lane._comment: Off for a new creator's first weeks: a viral-lane hit fills the follower count with people who came for the bit, and a stranger's first win should be in the lane they want to be known for. Turn it on when the primary lane has posted items.

schedule._comment: Written at onboarding step 10 and used to create a real recurring run at step 12. enabled=true means a scheduled job should exist; if the environment has no scheduler this records the intended cadence.

brand.name: Your Name (appears on carousel slides; defaults to 'creator' above)
brand._comment: colors.accent_text / accent_text_dark are OPTIONAL exact overrides; left empty they are derived from accent (darkened for light mode, lightened for dark). The Reach partner pill is part of the tool and is not configured here; byline set to "" hides the byline.

show._comment: All empty fields are written by the show-mode JOURNEY in references/the-show-template.md. Never prefill a name, turn line, or takeaway lines: the creator's own wording locks only when they pick it.

quantity._comment: Slots are FILMING slots the creator has confirmed for the week, not scripts. Write slots plus spares, then spend the remaining budget on 3 to 4 variations of the last measured winner. Defaults for the first 4 weeks; raise once 8 items are marked Posted. Unfilmed scripts carry no information back into the loop.

_comment_v2: 2026-09-09: audience, voice (as a block), quantity and secondary_lane.enabled added. The weekly run reads quantity instead of the old 'about 10 per lane' bar.
